caption: The drawing features two carved wooden figures standing side by side on a rectangular, dark brown base. The figure on the left appears to be a man dressed in black pants, a red-brown jacket, and a black cape or overcoat, with a white collar and a cap on his head. The figure on the right appears to be a woman wearing a reddish-brown dress with long sleeves and holding what looks like a round, yellow object in her arms. Both figures have brown faces and hands, and both are positioned upright and close to each other. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, allowing the carved figures and their base to stand out clearly. The artist's signature, "Sandler," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Carved Group: "Mennonites Homeward"
